subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding what a personal budget is and why people make one
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts income and expense cards into the correct category before building a simple budget
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a budget category (income, fixed expense, flexible expense) to an example
exercise.abstract: Student explains why having a budget helps someone manage their money

misconception_flags: confuses an expense with income, or vice versa

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
